about: The tool reach test of gate ET3 (scripts/live_eval_reach.py, tool_reach; council record 2026-11-22-eda-tools-seat-account.md, decision 2, item 3): a replay of flow/axil-timer dispatched on main at c99ef1fe (the merge of ip#444), run 45073595509, with the tools that read seat Verilog run as the seat account nirmaan-seat through /opt/nirmaan-seat/bin. The replay job's record and the rejudge job's record, each as the job uploaded it (live-eval-tool-reach-<job>-45073595509). Each shows, for Icarus (simulator.run), Verilator (lint.run), Yosys (synth.run) and SBY (formal.run, with a formal.cover control), a control on seat files of mode 0600 passed and three probes denied (a checkout canary, a runner-only canary, the parent's /proc/<pid>/environ holding a credential-named canary), and for the held-out compile a staged judge file read and a canary beside it denied, with no canary value in any run's log, summary or result file. It shows those probes denied through those tools as that account in that run, and nothing more. The live-eval job runs the same probes as a gate before its first trial and has no recorded run here.
